recent.label: Recent
recent.description: Tested within the last 2 years. Eligible to inform claim verdicts when matching.

ageing.label: Ageing
ageing.description: Tested between 2 and 5 years ago. Shown as context; product formulation may have changed.

old.label: Old / historical
old.description: Tested more than 5 years ago. Provided strictly as historical context; does not set CONTRADICTED.

unknown.label: Date unknown
unknown.description: Batch or publication date not stated. Treated as historical context.

standard_disclaimer: Reported evidence for the tested batch, not proof of wrongdoing.
batch_note: Results apply to the batch tested; the product may have changed since.
